note: Eleven pictures, one or two for each deep meaning (see "method" and "sections"), each made wide (1920x1088) and tall (1088x1920) from the same description. Biblical people are not portrayed (verse 12 names Cain) and nothing violent is shown.

scenes.principle: God's love has made us his children. That is who we are now, and we are growing to be like him.
scenes.shows: A small boy runs in through the open front door into waiting arms.
scenes.prompt: Seen from inside the bright hallway of a home, looking out through the wide-open front door: a small boy of about five with a little backpack runs in from the doorstep with a huge, joyful smile and his arms flung wide, straight toward two pairs of open arms reaching out to him from the near edges of the frame. Only the adults' outstretched arms and hands are visible. Warm light from inside the house falls on the boy's face. Clear morning daylight outside.

scenes.principle: God's love has made us his children. That is who we are now, and we are growing to be like him.
scenes.shows: A small boy stands in his father's big work boots.
scenes.prompt: A small boy of about four in pyjamas stands in the hallway of a home with both feet inside his father's huge, worn leather work boots, which reach almost to his knees. He looks down at them with a delighted, serious face. A man's work jacket hangs on a hook above him. No adult is in the picture. Clear, even daylight from an open doorway to the side. Framed so the boy and the boots are in the upper two thirds of the picture, with a wide strip of plain floor below the boots.

scenes.shows: Handcuffs fall open from a man's wrists, and another hand holds the key.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a man's two hands lifting apart as a pair of steel handcuffs falls open and away from his wrists. A second person's hand, at the edge of the frame, holds the small key that has just unlocked them. The freed wrists and the open handcuffs in mid-fall are in sharp focus. A plain room with bright daylight from a window behind. No uniforms, badges or lettering.

scenes.principle: Do not be fooled: your life shows whose child you are. What you do again and again shows the family you belong to.
scenes.shows: A small girl kneads dough exactly the way her mother does.
scenes.prompt: A kitchen worktop in bright morning light. A mother's flour-dusted hands knead a round of bread dough, and right beside them a small girl's hands knead a small piece of dough in exactly the same way, copying her. The girl, about five, standing on a stool, watches her mother's hands with deep concentration. The mother is seen only as hands, forearms and apron. A little flour hangs in the air. Framed so both pairs of hands and the dough are in the middle of the picture, with a wide strip of plain worktop below them.

scenes.shows: An older brother wraps his own jacket around his little brother in the cold.
scenes.prompt: A winter bus stop on a grey, frosty morning. A teenage boy wearing only a thin jumper is wrapping his own warm jacket around his small, shivering younger brother and zipping it up to his chin, and the little boy looks up at him. Both carry school bags. Flat grey daylight, their breath visible in the cold air. No signs or lettering.

scenes.principle: Love one another. Hating a brother is death at work in you, and love is how you know you are alive.
scenes.shows: One brother is praised at the family table while the other stares down, jaw tight.
scenes.prompt: A family dinner table at home in the evening under a warm ceiling lamp. On the right a young man smiles modestly while an older relative's hand, reaching in from the edge of the frame, rests proudly on his shoulder. On the left, in sharp focus, his brother, who looks much like him, sits apart with his arms folded, staring down at the table with a tight jaw and a dark, resentful look. Nobody else's face is visible.

scenes.shows: A man has fallen asleep at his brother's hospital bed, still holding his hand.
scenes.prompt: A hospital room in quiet early-morning light. A man lies asleep in the bed, pale but peaceful, and beside the bed his brother, who looks much like him, has fallen asleep in a chair, bent forward with his head resting on the mattress, still holding his brother's hand in both of his. The joined hands are in sharp focus. No screens with numbers and no lettering.

scenes.shows: A man wades through floodwater carrying an old man on his back.
scenes.prompt: A flooded residential street under a heavy grey sky. A man in ordinary soaked clothes wades waist-deep through brown floodwater toward the camera, carrying a frail elderly man on his back, the old man's arms around his neck. The carrier's face shows strain and determination. Rain is falling. Nobody else is in the frame. No signs or lettering.

scenes.shows: A workman breaks his sandwich and gives the bigger half to a man with nothing.
scenes.prompt: A city park bench at a cool, bright noon. A workman in a dusty work jacket has broken his sandwich in two and is holding out the bigger half to a thin, poorly dressed man sitting beside him, who looks at it in surprise. The workman's open lunch box rests on his knee. The offered half sandwich between their hands is in sharp focus.

scenes.prompt: A woman of about forty sits on a plain chair by a window with her eyes closed and her face lifted, her hands resting open and upturned in her lap, with a calm, confident, unafraid smile. Clear morning light from the window falls on her face and open hands. A simple, uncluttered room. No religious objects of any kind. Framed from the knees up, so her face and her open hands are both in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.shows: In a circle of people, one candle lights a child's candle.
scenes.prompt: Outdoors at dusk, a small circle of ordinary people of different ages stands close together, each holding a plain white candle. In the centre of the frame, in sharp focus, one person's lit candle is tilting to light the unlit candle of the child beside them, the new flame just catching. The faces around are warmly lit by candlelight and softly out of focus. Deep blue evening sky. No religious symbols.

method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.
